defects: Zoubida's right hand (screen left) clips into her blue bodice above the yellow sash, and her left fingers sink into the yellow sash at her hip.
tiles.fix: Pull both hands slightly outward along the hips so the fingers rest cleanly on the surface of the sash without intersecting the torso mesh.

defects: Wrong acting and direction for b007: instead of reaching up toward the door on the left to place a talisman over the doorway, Zoubida is turned three-quarters away facing right into the room in the same 'peering at beams' pose used in b008.
From this back-three-quarter angle, her raised right hand overlaps and clips into her headscarf so she looks like she is scratching her head, while her left hand clips into the front of her chest.
tiles.fix: Turn Zoubida to face screen-left toward the top of the doorway and extend her arm upward toward the door lintel so the talisman-placing gesture reads clearly in silhouette.

defects: Zoubida is pushed to the extreme left edge of the frame and turned away from the camera, so her raised right arm completely hides her face and clips into her headscarf instead of reading as shading her eyes to peer up at the ceiling beams.
Her bent left forearm intersects her chest mesh.
tiles.fix: Step Zoubida slightly into the room and rotate her torso into a three-quarter front/profile angle facing right so her face, upward eye-line, and brow-shading hand are visible to the camera.

defects: The dish cloth (torchon) is a rigid, flat rectangular slab sticking out of Zoubida's right wrist rather than a flexible cloth being whipped in the air.
Both of Zoubida's arms are raised straight up around her head, hiding her face behind her upper arm while her left hand floats disconnected from the cloth.
Missing ground contact shadow under Zoubida's feet on the carpet.
tiles.fix: Pose Zoubida in a clear one-handed overhead wind-up or slash with torso twist, keep her face unobstructed, and deform/drape the dish cloth along an arc of motion from one gripping hand.

defects: Instead of whipping the cloth to chase flies out, Zoubida holds both arms extended forward in a stiff, symmetrical sleepwalker pose with the rigid rectangular cloth suspended vertically between her hands like a laundry towel.
Zoubida's right hand clips through the top corner of the rigid cloth mesh.
tiles.fix: Give Zoubida a dynamic follow-through swatting pose with one arm whipping the cloth forward and the other counter-balancing, and bend/curve the cloth mesh so it trails the whipping motion.

worst_problem: In b009 (s03 48.7 and s03 53.1) the dish cloth is a rigid rectangular board held in stiff two-handed poses that obscure Zoubida's face and never read as whipping flies, while b007 (s03 28.8) reuses the b008 ceiling-peering pose facing away from the door instead of reaching up toward the doorway to place a talisman.
